text:
Predicates:
ContainsKnowledge(x) ::: x contains knowledge.
Reads(y, x) ::: y reads x.
GainsKnowledge(y, x) ::: y gains knowledge from x.
BecomesSmarter(y) ::: y becomes smarter.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
Title(x, y) ::: x has title y.
Premises:
∀x (Book(x) → ContainsKnowledge(x)) ::: Books contain tons of knowledge.
∀x ∀y (Reads(x, y) → GainsKnowledge(x, y)) ::: When a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge.
∀x (GainsKnowledge(x) → BecomesSmarter(x)) ::: If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter.
Reads(harry, walden) ::: Harry read the book “Walden” by Henry Thoreau.
Conclusion:
ContainsKnowledge(walden) ::: Walden contains knowledge.
